text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — the playbook sweeper fired an adhoc run and pushed a bunch of 'onboard_stale' nudges for accounts with last_activity > 90d. Seeing a spike in outbound emails and CS alerts. Not great during renewals week :grimacing:
Sam Ng: Ugh. Do we have a guard between dry-runs and realtime mode?
Maya Patel: We normally have the window set to 02:00-04:00 PST but logs show an adhoc flag flipped. From the run log: ```POST /playbook/run 200 {"run_id":"r_98a", "mode":"realtime"}```
CS Automations Bot: playbook-run r_98a completed — 342 actions — 278 nudges — 64 skipped (already-claimed) /alert
Eli Torres: Thanks for catching. Quick mitigation suggestion: set playbook.rate_limit=50/hr, add a freshness gate (last_activity < 60d), and soft-hold accounts with renewals <30d.
Maya Patel: I propose: add freshness gate, backfill exceptions for trial->paid, and soft hold for upcoming renewals. Also add an "automation:stale-touch" tag for telemetry.
Rowan Li: +1 on soft hold. We also need visibility into how many renewal accounts got touched. Without that ops will be blind — add a telemetry counter and tag.
Sam Ng: I'll draft the patch. Action plan: 1) pause scheduled runs 2) add gate to playbook config 3) run safe requeue script `scripts/requeue_safe.py --batch 100` 4) run audit query: `SELECT count(*) FROM touches WHERE tag='stale' AND renewal_date < now() + interval '30 days';`
Maya Patel: Owners for emergency ops: @Sam Ng and @Eli Torres. Sam, please post PR and ping eng-sre for a rollback play if needed. I'll coordinate CS comms for affected customers.
Sam Ng: On it. ETA ~45m. Pausing scheduler now.
Eli Torres: I'll run an eval sample of 200 accounts to measure healthscore delta post-nudge. If average delta > 0.1 we roll back.
CS Automations Bot: Note: next scheduled sweep at 03:00 PST was paused by Sam Ng at 1738554340.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Sam, tag me in the PR and I'll draft the outreach for impacted renewal cohorts.
